title: Re-add is a transition: only a named human door reopens a closed entry
deviations_from_card: (1) automation-run.ts left UNTOUCHED (write set shrunk): the rematch door is fixed by the store rule alone (created:false onto a rejected target now leaves it rejected, source not closed, applied 'already_rematched'); pinned by a runAutomationTask case with a seeded cache. (2) docs/features/integrations/README.md edited (one bullet REMOVED, not in the write set): its known gap 'a raced filing onto a scrubbed row can still re-open it' is exactly what this change closes, and leaving it would be a doc asserting a fixed defect. (3) An anonymized row now also takes NO fill-only backfill (github_json/github_handle/dev ids) - acceptance 8 says backfills apply 'whether or not a reopen was requested or refused'; that holds for not_requested/terminal_status/granted, but writing a GitHub handle back onto an erased row would re-attach scrubbed personal data, so the anonymized refusal skips it (pinned). (4) Refusal precedence: anonymized > terminal_status > not_requested, so a machine re-add onto an erased row reports 'anonymized', not 'not_requested'. (5) Outreach route: when the reopen is refused (role_closed/rematched/anonymized entry on that role) the route now returns 200 {applied:'suppressed_closed', reopened:false, reopenRefused} and drafts/sends nothing - useReachOut maps any suppressed* token to 'no message was sent', so no client change. Before, it revived the row and mailed; without this guard it would have mailed a still-closed row. (6) 15 cases instead of 8: added re-publish call shape, declined reopen, live-entry no-op, erased-no-backfill, ATS dedupe onto an erased rejected row (the r05 ats-sync gap), Reach-out refusal, and a source inventory that only the two recruiter doors pass `reopen`.
notes: Shared surfaces: catalogs committed alone under the lock (b1757c313, key pipeline.eventReasons.readdedByRecruiter appended after commandWaveReversed, real cs/de/fr); docs committed alone under the lock (0b7eac796). PIPELINE_REASON_CODES gains 'readdedByRecruiter' at the END (pipeline.ts only; the orphan copy in db/pipeline-events.ts untouched). No schema change, no new event kind. For candidate-apply-flow/A (wave 2): createPipelineEntry now returns CreatePipelineResult {entry, created, reopened, reopenRefused?}; the whole body is one db.transaction(...).immediate(); the stage is resolved BEFORE the tx (axis reads another store); readdReopenDecision(row, reopen) is the pure rule; put the keyed lookup + surrogate id + UNIQUE catch inside the tx closure. Every overage line on the live tree comes from siblings' uncommitted files combined with this. git diff --stat vs --ignore-all-space differ only by re-indentation of createPipelineEntry's body into the tx closure (no CRLF).
